section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1998 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 2.10.2 As in the past, 'Hanging' was the predominant mean for committing suicide, 17504 males and 9315 females brought end to their lives in 1998, using this method. More victims from Arunachal Pradesh (86.3%), A & N Islands (74.1%), D&N Haveli & Sikkim (66.7%) and Nagaland (60.0%) terminated their lives by hanging. The following table presents the State and UT-wise percentage share of suicide victims who adopted 'Hanging' and 'Poisoning' as the means to end their lives.
